function.name: local.process_start
function.description:
Execute a saved script by filename in absolute cwd. Save first with script_patch, script_write or local.fs_write. Extensions: .sh uses zsh, .py uses python3, .js/.mjs/.cjs use Bun. Optional args are literal strings. Each execution uses a private snapshot unaffected by later patches. No default timeout; optional timeoutMs terminates the process group when elapsed. Complete stdout/stderr are returned and persisted in stdoutPath/stderrPath. Returns processId immediately; use local.process_status, local.process_write and local.process_stop to interact. script_patch must run in an earlier call than this execution.
执行调度：serial（Runtime 固定，不必返回）。

cwd.description: 运行目录的绝对路径；默认取 <overview> 中的服务数据目录。

timeoutMs.description: 可选执行时限（毫秒），省略则不设时限；到期终止进程组
